claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_on_hit_trigger_component
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic weapon-hit rider, but current magic-item mechanics only allow passive grants, activated abilities, triggered reactions, or composites over those families. There is no honest non-spell on-hit delivery family for an equipped item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: replace_weapon_damage_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The rider changes the damage type of the weapon's hit from piercing to lightning. Existing atoms can add damage, change numeric damage, or grant resistances, but none substitute the damage type of an existing weapon hit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_return_after_thrown_activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Lightning Bolt activation deterministically returns the thrown weapon to the wielder immediately after resolution. The current attachment/lifecycle surface has no way to target the item itself and express that return behavior on a magic-item activation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.
